about: My work sits where public policy meets technology. I help public institutions move from paper-based, analogue processes to citizen-centric digital services, and make sure those systems are governed well: clear data ownership, sound architecture, secure operations and real adoption by the officials and citizens who depend on them.

I work across the full reform cycle: as-is analysis and policy research, process redesign with BPMN 2.0, system design and procurement, data governance frameworks, stakeholder engagement, training, and embedding after go-live.

My career began in software development and UN ICT operations, grew through disaster management and urban poverty programmes, and today centres on digital public infrastructure: Bangladesh's national business registry (RJSC), the NGO Affairs Bureau's e-governance platform, and e-government reform in health and civil registration.
cvProfile: E-governance and digital transformation professional with 18+ years of experience modernizing public institutions across Bangladesh. Expert in digital public infrastructure (DPI) design, business process re-engineering (BPMN 2.0), data governance and data management, policy analysis and development, change management, and ICT-enabled service reform. Delivered national-scale DPI for RJSC — Bangladesh's foundational business registry serving every registered company and firm — and NGOAB's integrated e-governance platform under UNDP's ISPAT project. Track record spanning the full reform cycle: as-is analysis, policy research, system design, data governance frameworks, stakeholder engagement, training, and post-deployment embedding across UNDP, USAID, and British Council-financed programmes. ISO 27001:2022 Lead Auditor | PMP | PRINCE2 | ITIL | Six Sigma Black Belt.

caseStudy.name: NGOAB Online Solutions
caseStudy.client: NGO Affairs Bureau, Prime Minister's Office
caseStudy.role: National Consultant – IT Expert, then Technical Project Implementation Expert (Apr 2025 – present)
caseStudy.challenge: Every NGO and foreign-funded project in Bangladesh is registered, approved and monitored by the NGO Affairs Bureau. The work relied on paper-based workflows across multiple offices, with field-level verification by district and upazila administrations.
caseStudy.solution: Four integrated online platforms — an NGO registration portal, a compliance tracking system, an SDG-aligned reporting dashboard and citizen-facing e-services — under an ISO 27001-based data governance framework, with role-based dashboards scoped to each user's role and jurisdiction.
